subject: Park Medford Paid Parking Program
overview: The Medford City Council organized for the 2015 legislative year by electing its council leadership. Councilors also held an extensive public discussion with city police officials, parking program representatives, local business owners, and residents regarding the rollout of the Park Medford paid parking system.

items.title: Election of Council President for 2015
items.summary: Elected Councilor Frederick Dello Russo Jr. as Council President for 2015.

items.title: Election of Council Vice President for 2015
items.summary: Elected Councilor Breanna Lungo-Koehn as Council Vice President for 2015.

items.title: Commendations for MHS Girls Soccer and Volleyball Teams
items.summary: Presented Council commendations to the Medford High School Girls Soccer and Volleyball teams, as well as league MVP Corey O'Rourke, for winning their respective Greater Boston League titles.

items.title: Adoption of Standing Committee Rules
items.summary: Adopted the standing committee rules as the standing rules of the City Council for 2015.

items.title: Transfer of 2014 Papers to 2015 Council
items.summary: Approved transferring all papers currently in committee or on the table from the 2014 Council to the 2015 Council.

items.title: Petition Regarding Medford Senior Center
items.summary: Tabled a petition by Mary Kay Benoit regarding the Medford Senior Center due to the petitioner's absence.

items.title: Petition on Non-Profits Use of Medford Name
items.summary: Referred a petition from Joseph Viglione concerning oversight of non-profits using the city's name to the Business and Economic Development Committee.

items.title: Claim Settlement: Dorothy Dixon v. City of Medford
items.summary: Approved a $5,000 personal injury claim settlement for Dorothy Dixon following a motor vehicle collision involving a city vehicle.

items.title: Discussion on Park Medford Paid Parking Program
items.summary: Heard public testimony from local business owners and residents expressing concern over the implementation of the new Park Medford paid parking system, and questioned Police Chief Leo Sacco and Republic Parking representatives regarding kiosk placements, enforcement rules, and business accommodations.

items.title: Adjournment Resolution in Memory of Michael J. Callahan
items.summary: Approved a resolution to adjourn the meeting in memory of former Governor's Councilor Michael J. Callahan on the fourth anniversary of his death.
